title: Clone Conspiracy #5 Marvel 2017 Dead No More Gabriele Dell'Otto Cover Dan Slott
conditionDescription: Short vertical crease at top center of the front cover through the title; otherwise bright with light wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Dead No More: The Clone Conspiracy #5 (April 2017), Marvel Comics - final issue of the Amazing Spider-Man event. Written by Dan Slott, art by Jim Cheung; painted cover by Gabriele Dell'Otto. Direct edition, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: M&M's 75th Anniversary Marvel Custom ad (Fantastic Four #1 homage).

Condition: short vertical crease at the top center of the front cover running through the title; otherwise bright with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
